name: Vicious circle: Femdom edition
source:
he game is about a young boy, an orphan, who has entered the most prestigious university in the country. During his studies, he will meet his love, but fate will determine that this encounter will radically change his life. His deepest dreams will come true, but will he be ready for such a change? Will he be able to proudly accept his fate?

[From F95Zone]

The VN is a remake of the developer's previous game "Vicious Circle".
translation:
该游戏讲述了一个孤儿小男孩进入该国最负盛名的大学的故事。在求学期间，他会遇到自己的爱情，但命运决定，这次邂逅将彻底改变他的人生。他最深切的梦想将会实现，但他准备好迎接这样的改变了吗？他能自豪地接受自己的命运吗？

[来自F95Zone]

VN是开发商之前的游戏“Vicious Circle”的重制版。
